last.verdict: Refining-driven profit beat expectations, lifting shares modestly despite lower production and oil prices.

reasons.label: Refining profits surged
reasons.text: Fuel margins pushed refining earnings to $4.9 billion from $1.1 billion a year earlier.

reasons.label: Beat on estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $5.28 topped the roughly $4.89 analyst average.

reasons.label: Cash and debt gains
reasons.text: Free cash flow near $14.2 billion; net debt fell to $20.7 billion from $34.5 billion.

story: Chevron has beaten profit forecasts for several quarters, helped first by high oil prices and now by refining. Oil-driven upstream profit is easing: Brent averaged $97, down from $104 last quarter. Shares have risen modestly after each report, as results were largely expected.

history.verdict: Huge profit beat, but investors expected it; shares gained a modest 2.4%.

reasons.label: Oil price windfall
reasons.text: Brent averaged $104 versus $68 a year ago; earnings jumped to $12.1 billion.

reasons.label: Beat, but priced in
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $6.06 topped roughly $5.55–5.80 forecasts, but high oil prices were already known.

reasons.label: Cash and cost wins
reasons.text: $3 billion cost savings hit six months early; debt cut a record $8.4 billion.
